headline: Nasdaq edged up after a Fed hold; Microsoft jumps after hours while Alphabet slips and BOJ decides tonight.
brief: The Nasdaq closed about 0.3% higher near the top of its range after the Fed held rates 10-2, with two members voting for a hike, while the 10-year yield rose about 6 bp and VIX eased. Microsoft rose about 4% after hours on a beat while Alphabet dipped on negative free cash flow, leaving mega-cap signals mixed. The Bank of Japan decision during the Asia session and higher yields are the key risks.

sources.title: Yahoo Finance: Fed holds rates in 10-2 vote
